gitCommit.subject: Public site: account deletion becomes a Dukan ERP documentation entry; the page is "Delete a Dukan ERP account"
gitCommit.body:
Public site: account deletion becomes a Dukan ERP documentation entry; the page is "Delete a Dukan ERP account"

TSX-MR is the company site; account deletion concerns its Dukan ERP product (the owner's approval of 2026-10-19).
- The Dukan ERP page ends with a quiet Documentation section whose one entry, "Account deletion", opens the localized
  deletion page (a text link with its arrow, not a card or a call to action; EN/FR/AR, light and dark, RTL).
- The general footer's Help column and the company pages' related-pages list no longer carry a standalone deletion
  link. The header navigation never did. The pages the app opens keep it in their footer, and Support keeps its
  Dukan ERP deletion section.
- The deletion page (1.1, effective 2026-10-19): "Delete a Dukan ERP account"; whose accounts these instructions
  concern, that browsing the website creates none, and that information sent by email or another enquiry is a separate
  request. Dukan ERP is still said to be not yet open; the deletion plan, identity check and retention wording are
  unchanged. Its addresses, /in-app/ variants included, do not move.
- Tests: test/deletion-docs.test.tsx (placement, absence, contextual links, addresses, heading, meta, in-app); the
  footer, related-link and version expectations updated; an e2e check that the entry opens the page at its top and the
  longer heading wraps at 320 and 375 px in light and dark.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01PLhoUhSVGTwofTQRXsJNof
